Meaning Vietnamese: phá tan bầu không khí ngượng ngùng, bắt đầu cuộc trò chuyện
Meaning English: to start a conversation or make people feel more comfortable
Origin: From the literal meaning of breaking ice to create a path for ships
Examples:
- John told a funny joke to break the ice at the meeting. => John kể một câu chuyện cười để phá tan bầu không khí ngượng ngùng trong cuộc họp. [business meeting]
- At parties, I always struggle to break the ice with new people. => Trong các bữa tiệc, tôi luôn gặp khó khăn trong việc bắt đầu cuộc trò chuyện với những người mới. [social situation]
Usage: Often used when describing social situations where people don't know each other well
Synonyms: start the conversation, get things going, warm up the atmosphere
Related Idioms: break down barriers, get the ball rolling

Meaning Vietnamese: tiết lộ bí mật, nói lộ chuyện
Meaning English: to reveal a secret or tell something that was supposed to be kept secret
Origin: From ancient Greek voting system where beans were used as ballots
Examples:
- Don't spill the beans about the surprise party! => Đừng tiết lộ chuyện bữa tiệc bất ngờ nhé! [keeping a secret]
- Sarah accidentally spilled the beans about her promotion. => Sarah vô tình tiết lộ chuyện thăng chức của cô ấy. [accidentally revealing information]
Usage: Usually refers to accidentally or intentionally revealing something that should have been kept secret
Synonyms: let the cat out of the bag, reveal the secret, tell all
Related Idioms: let slip, give away, blow the whistle

Origin: From the rare occurrence of two full moons in one calendar month
Examples:
- I only eat fast food once in a blue moon. => Tôi chỉ ăn đồ ăn nhanh rất hiếm khi thôi. [describing rare habits]
- My grandmother visits us once in a blue moon because she lives so far away. => Bà tôi hiếm khi đến thăm chúng tôi vì bà ở rất xa. [describing infrequent events]
Usage: Used to emphasize how infrequently something happens
Related Idioms: few and far between, once in a while, every now and then
